sources.source_name: Yahoo Finance daily adjusted close, current chart snapshot
sources.transformation: Last valid trading-day adjusted close in each calendar month; adjacent ratio minus one. Includes vendor dividend/split adjustments; do not add dividends again. Retrospective reconstruction, not an original historical database vintage. Normalized endpoints are committed for reproducible offline calculations.
